name: Lumi
description: Turns a phone camera into spoken, step-by-step guidance for blind and low-vision users, confirming every step on camera before moving on.

name: GitVenture
description: Turns GitHub issues into RPG quests. A Chrome extension puts AI-rated XP on every issue, and XP only unlocks when a maintainer merges your PR.

name: Issue-to-PR Agent
description: Label a GitHub issue, get a review-ready pull request back. The agent only opens a PR after the real test suite passes.

name: George
description: Hands-free voice agent for auto mechanics. Ask for torque and install specs out loud and get a short answer grounded in shop manuals.

name: Groovely
description: Dance app with AI pose analysis of your routines, video challenges, and social competition.

name: Bondedd
description: Campus event discovery for university students, pulling events scattered across Instagram, flyers, and group chats into one place.
